_comment.about: Two halves in one SDK, selected by the host's .rokct/config/app_type marker (core/utils/nextjs/sdk_installer_base.py install_sdk_files(): the top level always installs, ONE app_type block's installs/dependencies/integrations/requires merge in when its key matches the marker; sdk_composer.py strip_unused_role_folders() removes the other declared persona's templates/<persona>/ tree from the cache). app_type.control (1.0.0, unchanged): the control site's own frontend (rokct.ai) - the /handson/control/telephony admin page, the /portal/telephony customer portal (sign-up, checkout, top-up, subscription detail) and their services and actions, plus the sidebar nav line at // @rokct-sdk-nav-start. app_type.telephony (1.1.0): the storefront half, the home SDK of the telephony shell - Ray, 2026-09-09: "For telephony I suggest the hosting shape: a telephony_sdk landing half selling the Telephony plan category on control, telephony-frontend composed like hosting #6" - composed by core/utils/frappe/composer/telephony.json (home_sdk: true beside telemetry_sdk, base_sdk and auth_sdk; no agent_sdk, whose integrations are unconditional and flip the shell AI-first). It mirrors hosting_sdk 1.0.0 (hosting/nextjs) file for file: it owns app/page.tsx (every visitor is redirected to base_sdk's composed landing at /landing; the signed-in portal is the control block's, on the control site, so there is no signed-in home here) and fills every seam base_sdk's landing host offers with ONE registered module each: components/custom/landing/telephony-hero-copy.ts at // @rokct-sdk-hero-copy-start (base_sdk >= 1.6.0's hero-copy.ts; SIP lines, call routing and call history cycle as the headline, the trust line states the free plan, the 14-day Pro trial and the shared billing facts), telephony-hero-form.tsx at // @rokct-sdk-hero-form-start (base_sdk >= 1.7.0's hero-form.ts; two calls to action and no input, as hosting-hero-form.tsx), telephony-features-section.tsx and telephony-pricing-section.tsx at // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start (base_sdk >= 1.11.0's page-sections.ts; the pricing section declares meta.renders over the prefetched rows so the section and its Pricing nav stop drop together when the control site returns none, and notes 'per line' under a row whose is_per_seat_plan is set), telephony-header-menu.ts at // @rokct-sdk-header-menu-start (base_sdk >= 1.14.0's header-menu.ts; two anchors, features and pricing; no groups, no actions because base's header already draws Log in and Sign up, and since 1.1.1 brand: { logo: "none" }, base_sdk >= 1.21.0's HeaderMenu.brand - the home SDK declares the header logo, Ray 2026-09-09 14:15Z, and no telephony artwork exists, so the header draws the wordmark alone), telephony-site-metadata.ts at // @rokct-sdk-site-metadata-start (base_sdk >= 1.15.0's site-metadata.ts; declares its own SiteMetadataCopy-shaped interface rather than importing base's; no icon, so base_sdk >= 1.17.0's generated letter favicon applies; siteName "Rokct Telephony" is a flagged PLACEHOLDER, no source names the product), and telephony-plans-query.ts at // @rokct-sdk-plans-query-start (base_sdk >= 1.9.0's plans-query.ts; LANDING_CONFIG.plansQuery with ONE filter laid over its payload, ["plan_category", "=", "Telephony"], the category telephony/frappe's plan fixtures spell and control's telephony_signup.py filters on; no plan id or name anywhere in the filter). Their copy is components/custom/landing/telephony-page-sections.ts and the hero and metadata modules; every claim is a fact from telephony/frappe/src/fixtures (four Telephony Subscription Plans - Free and Pro, Monthly and Yearly - and their Items: the feature lines, is_free_plan, is_per_seat_plan, trial_period_days, USD, the billing cycles), from control/templates/pages/telephony_signup.html ("Subscribe to a Telephony Plan", "Pro plans are priced per line") or from this SDK's own control-portal templates (the area-code / DID sign-up steps, the Paystack top-up), and nothing a source does not carry is said. Colours route through the shell's theme tokens, never a literal brand colour. The base_sdk floor for the telephony block is 1.21.0 (since 1.1.1): telephony-header-menu.ts declares HeaderMenu.brand, which base_sdk 1.21.0 added, and against an older base the field is unknown to the registry's type and the compose fails to type-check. 1.1.0's floor was 1.20.0: the home_sdk composer (protocol #390) injects only the home SDK's line at the single-answer markers, hosting_sdk 1.0.0 set 1.19.0 as the floor for that, and 1.20.0 is the base that the hosting shell (hosting #6) composed against; every other registry this block targets exists from 1.15.0 (1.17.0 for the generated favicon it relies on by shipping no icon). base_sdk composes first, auth_sdk before this SDK because the landing's sign-up and login links are its routes. The control block's own floor is unchanged. 1.2.0 (Ray, 2026-11-01, of the approved concept: "proceed"): app/page.tsx no longer redirects to /landing; it draws the telephony landing - components/custom/landing/telephony-landing.tsx (server-safe) with telephony-landing.client.tsx (header theme switch and phone menu, the call-flow board, the Pro line calculator, reveal on scroll), every word in telephony-landing-config.ts (the way agent_sdk's agent-landing-config.ts holds rokct.ai's), the product's name in ONE value, TELEPHONY_SITE_NAME in telephony-brand.ts (the concept's "Rokct Telephony" until 1.2.1, now "Rokct Telecom", the name Ray chose), the scoped tokens in telephony-landing.css (teal accent #0F7A6E light / #2DD4BF dark, following the shell's next-themes class) and Gabarito, Geist and Geist Mono through next/font/google in telephony-fonts.ts. Prices are in rand, South Africa only: Starter R0 a month plus a once-off R50 that reserves the number (released after 3 months unused), Pro R185 per line a month including R185 of airtime, Unlimited R699 locked as Soon, free unlimited calls on our network on every plan. Icons are Remixicon only (@remixicon/react, declared with next-themes in this block's dependencies). The footer's last line is base_sdk >= 1.54.0's SiteCredit (`(c) <year> <site> - Built with <heart> by ROKCT`, the heart aria-labelled love), so the telephony block's base_sdk floor rises to 1.54.0. No client showcase. base_sdk's /landing and every registry module this block registers are unchanged, except telephony-site-metadata.ts, which now reads its site name from telephony-brand.ts and its description from the landing's. 1.2.1 (Ray, 2026-11-01): the product is named "Rokct Telecom" (TELEPHONY_SITE_NAME), and the header, hero and closing buttons read "Get your number", since Starter costs a once-off R50. 1.4.0 (Ray, 2026-11-01, chose the mark): the Rokct Telecom logo - a teal #0F7A6E rounded tile with a white "rt" and the wordmark "Rokct **Telecom**" (Telecom bold) - in ONE component, components/custom/landing/telephony-logo.tsx (server-safe), drawn in the landing header and the footer (not repeated in the open phone menu, which drops below the header bar), always linked to "/"; the tile stays the brand teal in light and dark (--mark-tile in telephony-landing.css), the wordmark follows the theme ink. The block now installs the icons: app/icon.svg and app/apple-icon.png (180px, full-bleed) by Next's file convention, and public/rokct-telecom-icon.png (512px) registered as `icon` in telephony-site-metadata.ts, so the favicon is the mark even where base_sdk's on-disk icon check misses the files, and base's header on /landing draws it (telephony-header-menu.ts brand.logo "auto", formerly "none"). The 1.3.0 number belongs to the open header-auth change (hardware#69).

_comment.components/custom/header-auth-slot.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.60.0 with components/custom/landing/header-auth.ts (HeaderAuthSlot and the HEADER_AUTH registry: the header's Log in / Sign up slot, filled by the SDK that owns sign-in - auth_sdk >= 1.11.0 - and empty without one). TelephonyHeader renders it in .nav-end and in #tel-mobile-menu in place of its hard-coded Log in link, and the footer shows its Log in only when hasHeaderAuth() (Ray, 2026-11-01: sites that compose auth_sdk show Log in / Sign up in the header). telephony_sdk 1.3.0 therefore needs base_sdk >= 1.60.0
